body:
Source: GitHub issue #759 (P1-high, false-green), second half; plus stale router prose found while fixing #760. Builds on #1219 (commit cef30805), which bound p4-build to the tree via p4EvidenceBindingErrors in packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs and left flail-check presence-only because the flail detector records no tree identity.

PROBLEM. 'adlc run p4' accepts a flail-check entry on bare presence: flail-check recorded against an older tree still satisfies p4 after the files have changed (the same false-green #759 reports for p4-build). packages/flail-detector/bin/flail-detector.mjs --record appends a 'flail-check' entry carrying only the log path/hash, no files.
Separately, scripts/router/router-model.mjs states 'P0, P1, P3, P4, P5, and P6 assertions are ticket-scoped' in the codex and pi routers (around lines 103 and 121); after #1219 p2 is ticket-scoped too.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Work from the worktree root. Packages: packages/flail-detector (bin/flail-detector.mjs --record path, lib/*; tests in packages/flail-detector/test, record.test.mjs covers --record), packages/runner (lib/assertions.mjs p4EvidenceBindingErrors; tests p2-p4-evidence-binding.test.mjs from #1219). The file-hash helper is hashFiles in packages/core/lib/ledger.mjs (also what 'gate-manifest record --files' uses) — reuse it, do not reimplement. Shipped call sites that record flail-check: plugins/adlc-opencode/command/adlc-verify-build.md, plugins/adlc-pi/prompts/adlc-verify-build.md, plugins/adlc-cursor/command/adlc-verify-build.md; grep plugins/ and docs/ for any other (including generated or mirrored copies and tests that assert prompt text) before editing. They record flail-check BEFORE p4-build, so NO ordering rule between the two markers may be introduced. The router is generated: edit scripts/router/router-model.mjs then run 'node scripts/router/gen-routers.mjs' and commit the regenerated harness files; the router-drift test and CI job must stay green.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. flail-detector --record accepts --files <comma-separated paths> (same value grammar and path handling as 'gate-manifest record --files'); on a clean verdict the recorded flail-check entry gains a 'files' map of path -> sha256 produced by hashFiles. --record without --files still records (back compat) but with no files map. An unreadable --files path is an operational error (exit 1) and nothing is recorded. Exit codes and verdict logic unchanged.
2. packages/runner: ONE exported validator covers both markers. p4EvidenceBindingErrors (or a renamed generalisation, keeping its export if tests import it) checks the LATEST p4-build and the LATEST flail-check for the ticket; each must bind a non-empty files map whose hashes all match the current worktree; messages follow the existing wording, naming the marker and file ('P4 evidence is stale: file changed after flail-check was recorded: <path>' etc). A flail-check with no files map is rejected as incomplete (fail closed) — direction asserted in a test. Absent markers are still reported only by the presence check.
3. Update the three verify-build prompts so the flail-detector --record invocation passes --files <changed files> (the same changed files as p4-build), and fix their prose about what p4 asserts. Any test pinning the old prompt text is rewritten (say so in the PR body).
4. Router: add P2 to the ticket-scoped sentence everywhere it appears in router-model.mjs, regenerate, commit generated outputs. No other router content changes.
5. Documentation: update packages/flail-detector/README.md and packages/runner/README.md and make the SAME edits by hand in apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/flail-detector.mdx and runner.mdx (hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 flail-detector --record --files records a files map matching sha256 of the files; unreadable path exits 1 with nothing recorded; no --files records no map. verify: `node --test packages/flail-detector/test/record-files.test.mjs`
- AC2 'adlc run p4' with a flail-check recorded, then a bound file edited -> exit 2 naming flail-check and the file; unchanged tree -> exit 0. verify: `node --test packages/runner/test/flail-check-binding.test.mjs`
- AC3 flail-check without files -> exit 2 (incomplete); flail-check recorded before p4-build still passes when both are fresh (no ordering rule). verify: `node --test packages/runner/test/flail-check-binding.test.mjs`
- AC4 At least one test drives the real flail-detector bin and the real runner bin end to end. verify: `node --test packages/runner/test/flail-check-binding.test.mjs`
- AC5 The three verify-build prompts pass --files to flail-detector --record. verify: `grep -c "flail-detector.*--files" plugins/adlc-opencode/command/adlc-verify-build.md plugins/adlc-pi/prompts/adlc-verify-build.md plugins/adlc-cursor/command/adlc-verify-build.md` (each >= 1)
- AC6 Router states p2 is ticket-scoped and generated outputs are in sync. verify: `node scripts/router/gen-routers.mjs` leaves no diff, and the router-drift test passes.
- AC7 Existing suites and consumers green. verify: `npm test -w packages/flail-detector`, `npm test -w packages/runner`, plugin tests that touch the prompts.
- AC8 Docs updated in both places. verify: grep the new statement in each README and mdx.
- AC9 Mutation gate green. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also --max 80 locally).

OUT OF SCOPE: p5/p6 revision logic; adding an ordering rule between p4-build and flail-check; other router wording changes.
title: runner/flail-detector: flail-check evidence is bound to the tree like p4-build; router states p2 is ticket-scoped
